title: Arguments of `board.show` (a new panel on the Board)
description: The `authz.object.args` of a live `board.show` action: one whole panel, as core stored it. The node checks the limits and the hash, stores the panel, and answers `RENDERED` only after the Board has drawn this revision.

kind.description: `text`: formatted text (Markdown, no raw HTML). `canvas`: one self-contained HTML page, shown sealed. `drawing`: `content` is the canonical JSON description of a picture (engine, version, units, items, steps, and the picture's hash, size and media type); the picture itself arrives in `board.content` chunks. Core and the node check the description; the schema cannot.

title.description: One line: 1 to 120 Unicode code points, no control character, not blank.

content.description: At most 30,000 bytes of UTF-8, with no control character except tab, line feed and carriage return. JSON Schema counts characters, so core and the node also count bytes.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of `content`'s UTF-8 bytes, lower-case hex.

cost_paise.description: What this panel has cost to make so far, all revisions together, in paise (0 when the cost is carried by another panel of the same job).
